name: River City Bank
summary:

subject: River City Bank Reported In-line with Estimates

name: Infosys Limited
summary:

The consensus earnings estimate was $0.21 per share on revenue of $5.18 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.21 per share. Infosys Ltd provides end-to-end business solutions, including consulting, design, development, software re-engineering, maintenance, systems integration, package evaluation and implementation and infrastructure management services.
subject: Infosys Limited Missed Expectations, Lowers Guidance to be Closer to Estimates

name: Gentex Corporation
summary:

Gentex Corp designs and manufactures automatic-dimming rearview mirrors and electronics for the automotive industry, dimmable aircraft windows for the aviation industry, and commercial smoke alarms and signaling devices for the fire protection industry.
